task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler named 'Retrospective Dashboard' visible in the wiki sidebar or story river.

task_completion.description: The dashboard tiddler must contain a button labeled 'Start New Retrospective'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A button element within the 'Retrospective Dashboard' tiddler with the exact text 'Start New Retrospective'.

task_completion.description: Clicking the button generates a new tiddler with the correct date-based title format.

task_completion.description: The generated tiddler must inherit the text body from the 'Retrospective Template'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The body of the 'Sprint Retrospective - YYYY-MM-DD' tiddler contains the same headers and bullet points defined in the template.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and configure tiddlers rather than just editing underlying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking the '+' button, typing into the TiddlyWiki edit fields, and clicking 'done' or 'save' icons.

integrity.description: The new tiddler was generated by clicking the dashboard button, not by manual creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: The cursor is seen hovering over or clicking the 'Start New Retrospective' button followed by the appearance of the new tiddler.

integrity.description: The agent used TiddlyWiki variables/macros for the date rather than hardcoding a specific string in the button code.
integrity.visual_evidence: If the button code is visible, it should use syntax like <<now 'YYYY-0MM-0DD'>> or similar TiddlyWiki date variables.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template must be titled 'Retrospective Template'. The dashboard must be titled 'Retrospective Dashboard'. The generated tiddler must be titled 'Sprint Retrospective - [Current Date]' in YYYY-0MM-0DD format. Required tags for the generated tiddler are 'Meeting' and 'Retrospective'. The content must match the template headers: '! What went well', '! What could be improved', and '! Action Items'.
